column1: # The shape of every row family of manifests/family_model.json: consent (binds = signer | signer+holder | body+holder), door, claim or content;

# confidence: stated (a quote or a kernel table says it) | cells (follows from the cells) | reading (the shape is this table's reading).
# class=WHAT: a family no shape runs, saying what it is and why, with its source; check_shapes.py reports it `no shape, stated`, not `cannot run`.
